name: the-floating-class-goes-when-the-panel-does
description: The panel's wash is scoped to html.atrium-sidebar-floating, so a class that outlives the panel paints the DOCKED sidebar as a flat slab and the desktop stops reading through it. Two dismissals are graded. Leaving the panel runs FinishHide, which clears the span. Cmd+S taken while the panel is up does not: BrowserController::ToggleSidebar sees revealed_by_hover and calls ForgetReveal, which only drops the edge zone. That branch was written when a reveal expanded the docked pane rather than opening a child window.
